title: GREG as a persistent, founder-sovereign operating layer on owned compute
statement: The first computer is UNIIMENTE's first body. Alfonso should eventually be able to download GREG, install it on a computer he owns, connect chosen accounts, models, APIs and permissions, give it durable goals, leave it working within bounded authority, inspect receipts and critique its work from the computer or phone, and expand practical capability without expanding constitutional authority. Morphogenesis means finding, acquiring, composing, adapting or building a missing functional capability and then resuming the original goal. A complete business operator with AI and human workers, and economically justified additional compute, remains the long-range destination.
